focus: A14 server API clients in the repo: which repo code talks to an OpenCode server or SDK directly, and how does each call map from v1 to v2?

graphEvents.label: Which repo code talks to an OpenCode server or SDK, and how does each call map v1 to v2?
Repo has zero server API clients; five in-process ctx.client call sites, two type-only SDK imports, one UTCP false positive
session.messages maps to GET /api/session/{id}/message with changed response shape; tui.showToast has no v2 route
@opencode/client 2.0.32 is the v2 client with no createOpencodeClient; repo pins @opencode-ai/plugin 1.18.34 only
v2 remote-attach looks pairing/credential based, not --attach URL based

label: The repo contains zero OpenCode server API clients: no createOpencodeClient, no opencode serve, no OPENCODE_SERVER, no client.app.*, no client.config.* and no raw HTTP/SSE to a server anywhere in .skilled/ or .opencode/. The entire client surface is five in-process ctx.client/pluginInput.client call sites - session.messages at .opencode/plugins/system-completion-sentinel.js:79, session.messages at .opencode/plugins/system-skill-advisor.js:1231, session.promptAsync at .opencode/plugins/opencode-goal.js:2685, session.messages at .skilled/skills/sk-vision/vision-runtime/src/opencode/command.ts:89 and tui.showToast at .skilled/skills/sk-vision/vision-runtime/src/plugin.ts:46 plus the duplicate hook build at .skilled/skills/sk-vision/hooks/opencode/sk-vision.ts:57 - plus three type-only @opencode-ai/sdk imports that erase at compile time (command.ts:6, attachments.ts:9, plugin.ts:33). The mcp-code-mode client.config.tool_repository calls at .skilled/skills/mcp-code-mode/mcp-server/index.ts:276/:311 are the UTCP tool repository bound at :274, not OpenCode. Every 4096 hit is prose or an unrelated byte-size constant. Consequence: the client leg has no server client to port; the whole v1-to-v2 mapping is exhaustively three methods across four plugins.

v1-to-v2 client method mapping is three-way: (a) client.session.messages({path:{id},query:{limit}}) maps to GET /api/session/{sessionID}/message - path noun singular, limit retained but order/cursor/type added, and the response is SessionMessagesResponse {data: Session.Message.Info[], cursor:{previous,next}} where the v1 list carries {info,parts} pairs and no parts appears in the v2 list schema, so the sentinel's textFromAssistantEntry step at .opencode/plugins/system-completion-sentinel.js:89 has no parts to read; (b) client.session.promptAsync maps cleanly to POST /api/session/{sessionID}/prompt, whose response {data: Session.Inbox.User} shows the prompt is enqueued into an inbox, with POST /api/session/{sessionID}/generate {prompt} as the simpler alternative; (c) client.tui.showToast has NO v2 equivalent - toast and showToast do not occur anywhere in the 119-path v2 OpenAPI document or its component schemas, and the only tui token is Plugin.Features.tui, a declarative capability flag, so sk-vision's user-facing notify path is an irreducible API gap requiring POST /api/rpc/{rpcID}/{method} or a graceful drop.

The client dependency split is version-aligned: npm @opencode-ai/sdk latest is 1.19.3 (the v1 client, tracking the v1 host) and @opencode/client is 2.0.32 (the v2 client, matching the v2 pin exactly) whose export map is . , ./solid, ./effect, ./promise, ./service, ./effect/api, ./promise/api, ./effect/service and contains NO createOpencodeClient factory - the v2 client is a promise/effect/service-surface library, a different construction API rather than a rename. Neither package is a dependency here: .opencode/package.json:7 and .skilled/package.json:4 both pin only @opencode-ai/plugin 1.18.34, so the shipped plugin contract is already one minor behind the 1.19.x v1 host being targeted and two minors behind 2.0.32, which means every v1-side plugin-contract answer gathered in iterations 1-3 was measured against a pin older than the host.

v2's remote-attach story appears structurally different from the documented --attach <url>: the v2 spec carries POST /api/pair, GET /auth/connect/{code}, GET|POST /api/credential with POST /api/credential/{credentialID}/activate and /api/integration/{id}/connect/{key,oauth,external}, and no route a bare --attach URL would land on, suggesting paired credentials rather than a URL. --attach in this repo is documentation only - .skilled/skills/cli-external-orchestration/cli-opencode/SKILL.md:31, :81, :165, README.md:91, references/opencode-tools.md:90, references/cli-reference.md and playbook CO-030 - with zero code references, and CO-030 itself declares live remote execution out of scope, so --attach has never been executed on either version. Recorded as P1 risk, not an asserted break.

The deep-loop cli-opencode executor needs no client mapping: buildOpencodeLineageCommand at .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs:2324 emits opencode run --model <m> --format json --dir <root> [--dangerously-skip-permissions] [--variant <e>] <prompt> (:2329-:2351) and resolves the binary version at :2286/:2359 via resolveExecutableVersion, never constructing a client, opening a socket or reading a session, so iteration 13's A11 flag-and-subcommand matrix is the whole story for this file.

Plugin.Features is a real and new v2 plugin contract with no v1 counterpart: components.schemas Plugin.Features is {server?: true, tui?: true, rpc?: true} with each member typed enum:[true] rather than boolean, and Plugin.Info requires source, features and state. A v2 plugin therefore declares which runtime surface it needs; tui:true is the only v2 token naming the TUI at all, which is the first hard evidence for how a v2 plugin advertises TUI access and the natural next question for sk-vision's toast gap.

direction: Porting a repo-owned OpenCode server client to v2 - there is no createOpencodeClient, opencode serve, OPENCODE_SERVER, client.app.* or raw HTTP/SSE call site anywhere in the repo, so no server-client layer exists to port
reason: Exhaustive grep of .skilled/ and .opencode/ for @opencode-ai/sdk, createOpencodeClient, opencode serve, OPENCODE_SERVER, client.session., client.tui., client.app., 127.0.0.1:4096, localhost:4096, /session/, /api/event and fetch(...4096) returned only the five in-process ctx.client sites, three type-only imports and one UTCP false positive

direction: Mapping the mcp-code-mode client.config.tool_repository calls as an OpenCode API surface requiring v2 equivalence
reason: .skilled/skills/mcp-code-mode/mcp-server/index.ts:274 binds const client = await initializeUtcpClient(), so getTools/getTool at :276/:311 are the UTCP tool repository, not OpenCode

direction: Assuming a single client dependency specifier can serve both versions - @opencode-ai/sdk (1.19.3) and @opencode/client (2.0.32) are separate packages with different construction APIs
reason: npm view shows version-aligned separate packages, and @opencode/client's export map has no createOpencodeClient factory; however only type-only imports of @opencode-ai/sdk exist in this repo, so a single plugin tree can sidestep the specifier split by inlining the three erased types
